title: Stable Mesh-Free Variational Radial Basis Function Approximation for Elliptic PDEs and Obstacle Problems
summary: We present a comprehensive study of radial basis function (RBF) approximations for elliptic and obstacle-type boundary value problems under a variational formulation. Our focus is on practical accuracy, robustness and efficiency. To address ill-conditioning in dense systems, we apply truncated singular value decomposition (TSVD) and investigate its effect on stability and accuracy trade-offs. Numerical experiments report benchmarks on accuracy and show fast error decay.
